newsitem.title: USA: Nu-Tech blames stock decline on rumor.
newsitem.headline: Nu-Tech blames stock decline on rumor.

text.p: Nu-Tech Bio-Med said Friday the decline of the price of its stock on the Nasdaq stock exchange was possibly due to an "unfounded and untrue rumor" that its president, Marvin Feigenbaum, had resigned.

"The company further stated, based on supposition only, that such (a) decline could be attributable to possible sales by shareholders pursuant to a recently effective S-3 registration," it said. "(It could also be) the anticipated filing of an additional registration statement for additional selling shareholders, margin calls, if any."

The company also said it was not aware of any business developments or events that might have not been disclosed in the company's filings with the securities and exchange commission. Its stock closed at 6-1/2 on Friday against a year low of 8-12/32.
